THE PROBLEM

Why I built this platform

What business owners face

  • They have a good business plan but no way to reach an investor.
  • Banks ask for collateral that a small business cannot give.
  • They post in Facebook groups and get replies they cannot trust.

What investors face

  • They have money to invest but no list of real opportunities.
  • Proposals arrive with no identity proof and no documents.
  • Nothing records what was promised, so there is no safety.
SAY THIS

In Bangladesh, small businesses and investors both exist, but they cannot find each other safely. Today they meet through Facebook groups or personal contacts, where nobody is verified and nothing is recorded. My project solves this problem.

THE SOLUTION

What InvestorHub does

Four things the platform guarantees

  • Verified people: every member uploads a NID and an admin approves the account.
  • Approved listings: every post is checked by an admin before the public can see it.
  • Controlled contact: chat opens only between an investor and a business owner.
  • Recorded money: every payment goes through SSLCommerz and is verified by the server.

One sentence

  • InvestorHub is a moderated marketplace where an investor and a business owner can find each other, talk to each other, and complete the investment in one place.
SAY THIS

InvestorHub is a moderated marketplace. Verification, approval, controlled communication and recorded payment — these four ideas are the heart of my project.

USERS

Who uses the platform

Guest

  • Any visitor.
  • Can browse and search listings.
  • Can register or contact us.
  • No login needed.

Investor

  • Has money to invest.
  • Publishes an investment offer.
  • Sends match requests.
  • Pays through the gateway.

Businessman

  • Needs funding.
  • Publishes a funding request.
  • Accepts or rejects requests.
  • Receives the net amount.

Administrator

  • Approves accounts and listings.
  • Handles reports.
  • Monitors payments.
  • Reads the analytics.
SAY THIS

The platform has three human roles plus the public visitor. An investor gives money, a businessman needs money, and the administrator keeps the platform safe.

TECHNOLOGY

What the system is built with

Frontend

  • React 19 with Vite
  • Tailwind CSS for the design
  • Redux Toolkit for state
  • React Router for the pages

Backend

  • Node.js with Express
  • JWT for authentication
  • bcrypt for password hashing
  • express-validator for input checks

Database and real time

  • MongoDB with Mongoose
  • Twelve collections
  • Socket.IO for live chat
  • Indexes for fast search

External services

  • SSLCommerz payment gateway
  • Google Gemini for the assistant
  • Image hosting for uploads
  • MongoDB Atlas for the live database
SAY THIS

It is a MERN stack project: MongoDB, Express, React and Node. Socket dot IO gives the live chat, SSLCommerz handles the money, and Gemini powers the help assistant.

PART 2

Becoming a verified member

After registration the user must complete three steps before the dashboard opens

STEP 2 OF 3

Pay the one-time entry fee

/entry-fee

  • Every new member pays BDT 100, one time only.
  • Paid with card, bKash, Nagad or bank through SSLCommerz.
  • It keeps the platform limited to serious members.
  • The account cannot continue until the fee is settled.
SAY THIS

The first gate is the entry fee. It is a small one-time payment that keeps out people who are not serious, and it funds the platform.

STEP 3 OF 3

Identity verification with NID

/onboarding

  • The member uploads a clear photo of the NID or date of birth card.
  • The image is stored and shown only to the admin.
  • The page refuses to submit without a file.
  • The account then moves to the admin review queue.
SAY THIS

The second gate is identity. Every member must upload a national ID, which only the admin can see. This is what makes the platform trustworthy.

PART 6

Behind the scenes

How the system protects the user, the money and the data

SECURITY

How the platform stays safe

Accounts

  • Passwords are hashed with bcrypt and never returned by the API.
  • A signed JWT token is required for every protected route.
  • The role and the account status are checked on the server, not in the browser.

Content and abuse

  • Every listing is approved by a human before it is public.
  • All input is validated on the server with express-validator.
  • Rate limiting stops one client from flooding the API.

Privacy

  • The NID image is visible only to the owner and the admin.
  • Contact details are hidden until a match is accepted.
  • Card details never touch my server — the gateway handles them.
SAY THIS

Security was designed into the project, not added at the end. The three areas are the account, the content and the privacy of personal data.

PAYMENT

How the money moves — and why it is safe

1
Investor clicks InvestEnters the amount on the listing page
2
Server creates a sessionA unique transaction id is generated and stored
3
Gateway page opensThe investor pays with card, bKash, Nagad or bank
4
Gateway calls backSuccess, fail or cancel is returned to my server
5
Server re-validatesThe payment is checked again with the gateway API — a callback alone is never trusted
6
SettlementCommission deducted, match finalized, listing marked funded, invoice generated
SAY THIS

This is the most important technical part. I never trust the browser redirect. The server asks the gateway again whether the payment is genuine, and the same payment can never be counted twice.

REAL TIME

How live chat works

Connection

  • The browser opens a Socket.IO connection.
  • The identity is taken from the JWT token at handshake time.
  • A stale socket from a previous login is rejected.

Conversation

  • Both users join a room for their conversation.
  • A new message is pushed to everyone in that room.
  • Typing and seen events use the same channel.

Storage

  • Every message is stored in MongoDB.
  • The conversation list shows the last message.
  • History is loaded when the conversation is opened.
SAY THIS

The chat is not refreshing the page again and again. It keeps one open connection, so a message appears on the other screen immediately, and it is also saved in the database.

DATA

The database — 12 collections

People

  • users — identity, role, status
  • investorprofiles — investment preferences
  • businessmanprofiles — company details

Activity

  • posts — listings
  • matches — the pair and its state
  • conversations and messages — the chat

Money

  • investments — amount, commission, net
  • feepayments — the entry fee
  • reviews — one per account

Support

  • reports — complaints from members
  • contactmessages — public enquiries
  • Indexes on the fields used for search
SAY THIS

All data lives in twelve MongoDB collections. Every collection has a schema that fixes the field types and the allowed values, so the data stays disciplined.

RESULT

What is complete, what is next

Completed

  • All three roles with full dashboards.
  • Verified onboarding with entry fee and NID.
  • Listing publication with admin moderation.
  • Matching, real-time chat and reporting.
  • Gateway payment with commission and PDF invoice.
  • Admin analytics and the AI assistant.

Known limitations

  • Identity is verified manually by the admin.
  • The platform holds no escrow account.
  • Matching is by search, not by recommendation.
  • The interface is English only.

Future plan

  • Escrow to release funds on a milestone.
  • A recommendation engine for matching.
  • Automatic NID verification.
  • Bangla interface and mobile app.
  • Email and push notifications.
SAY THIS

The core platform is complete and working end to end. I am honest about the limitations, and each of them has a clear plan in the next version.
